label: Bible Study
prompt: But Noah found _____ in the eyes of the LORD.
verse: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
note: The first time 'grace' appears in the KJV — and it lands on Noah, just before the flood.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose _____ thou art come to trust.
verse: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.
note: Boaz blesses the Moabite widow with refuge under God's wings — then becomes part of the answer himself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And why beholdest thou the _____ that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verse: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
note: Modern versions say speck; the KJV says mote — while you ignore the beam, a whole plank, in your own eye.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the _____ of life.
verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
note: 'Issues' means outflows — the heart is the wellhead, and everything downstream tastes like it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of _____; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
verse: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
note: Beauty for ashes, praise for 'heaviness' — from the very passage Jesus read aloud in the Nazareth synagogue.
